showcase.user_prompt: 做一个 10 秒的产品介绍视频并导出 MP4。
showcase.assistant_reply: 我会在当前对话工程中编写 Remotion 组件，并使用本地渲染器导出视频。

items.title: 标准 React 工程
items.description: 源码、依赖、资源和输出都保存在当前对话目录。

items.title: 原生 CLI 渲染
items.description: 调用工程本地 Remotion CLI，保留配置文件和扩展能力。

items.title: 任务进度
items.description: 渲染通过媒体任务运行，支持查询进度和取消。

items.title: 直接输出 MP4
items.description: 完成的视频写入工程 out 目录，可在文件列表中预览。

showcase.user_prompt: Create a 10-second product video and export it as MP4.
showcase.assistant_reply: I will build the Remotion components in this conversation project and render the video locally.

blocks.title: Each conversation is a Remotion project

items.title: Standard React project
items.description: Source, dependencies, assets, and output stay in the conversation directory.

items.title: Native CLI rendering
items.description: Uses the project's local Remotion CLI, including its config and extensions.

items.title: Job progress
items.description: Rendering runs as a media job with progress and cancellation support.

items.title: MP4 output
items.description: Completed videos are written to out and can be previewed from the file list.
